s1.ptxt: To facilitate reinstallation, provide matchmarks (1) on drive end frame (2) and stator assembly (3) as shown.
Remove rear end cover (2) and bushing (1).
Remove brush holder assembly (1) from stator assembly.
With lever inserted between stator assembly (1) and drive end frame (2), separate generator into drive end frame and stator assembly.

attention4.ptxt: The rotor assembly may be damaged if it is not held in a vise in the specified method and at the indicated parts when loosening the pulley nut.
Hold the rotor assembly in the vise via a clean cloth (3) at the iron parts (4). Never hold the rotor assembly at other parts (5).

s1.ptxt: Remove rotor (1) from drive end frame (2) by tapping shaft (3) lightly using plastic hammer.
If necessary, remove bearing retainer screws and bearing retainer (1), and then remove bearing (2) from drive end frame (3) using special tool.

attention3.ptxt: If necessary, when removing bearing heat drive end frame to a temperature of 80 – 100 °C (176 – 212 °F) so that it will not be distorted.

s1.ptxt: Using special tool, install new bearing to drive end frame. Check the bearing for smooth rotation, if removed.

attention4.ptxt: When installing the bearing, the bearing and the drive end frame may become damaged if pressing any section other than the outer race.
Press the outer race of the bearing when installing it.

s1.ptxt: Install bearing retainer (1) to drive end frame (2), and then tighten bearing retainer screws to specified torque.

attention4.ptxt: The rotor may be damaged if it is not held in a vise in the specified method and at the specified parts when tightening the pulley nut.
Hold the rotor in the vise via a clean cloth (3) at the iron parts (4). Never hold the rotor at other parts (5).

s2.ptxt: Tighten pulley nut (6) to specified torque.

s1.ptxt: Install stator assembly (1) to drive end frame (2).
Tighten rear end frame bolts to specified torque.
Install brush holder assembly (1) using the following procedure.

s2.ptxt: Hold brushes in compressed position, by inserting a pin (3) into stopper hole (4).

attention3.ptxt: Recommended pin diameter: About 1.0 mm (0.04 in.)

s2.ptxt: Install brush holder assembly to stator assembly (5), and then tighten brush holder assembly screws (6) to specified torque.
Remove pin from brush holder assembly.

s1.ptxt: Install rear end cover (2) to stator assembly, and then tighten rear end cover bolts (3) to specified torque.
